title: My Island
subtitle: A competitive legacy hexagonal tile-placement campaign developing a thriving tropical paradise
tagline: Chart your island, place hexagonal settlements, and uncover secrets through eight evolving eras.
loreSummary: Having sailed uncharted waters to discover a secluded tropical archipelago, players compete to build homesteads, plant palm groves, pave roads, and unearth ancient mysteries across their own evolving island board.
keyFeatures: Competitive legacy game structured into 8 sealed chapter envelopes with 24 total episodes
Clever hexagonal tile placement with simultaneous play and evolving spatial scoring rules
Permanent board evolution using stickers to add paths, palm groves, walls, and ancient statues
Accessible rules by legendary designer Reiner Knizia combining relaxation and puzzle depth

my_island_campaign.name: Full Legacy Campaign (8 Chapters)
my_island_campaign.description: The complete 24-episode legacy journey opening all eight secret envelopes from first arrival to paradise.

my_island_settlement_era.name: Pioneering Era (Chapters 1–4)
my_island_settlement_era.description: The first 12 episodes establishing initial beaches, agricultural fields, paths, and perimeter walls.

my_island_monuments_era.name: Monuments Era (Chapters 5–8)
my_island_monuments_era.description: The culminating 12 episodes unearthing mysterious statues, building village hubs, and botanical gardens.
